## What does the spread tell us?

Compare the largest and smallest reading. Their difference is the range, or spread. It describes how much these readings vary. It does not prove the tool is accurate.

**Provided practice data:** 15 5/8, 15 11/16, 15 5/8, 15 9/16 and 15 5/8 inches. These are example measurements, not a survey of our building.

## Case B - Route the drain through the service zone

This is a dry classroom coordination model, not an installation approval or permission to alter framing. Original horizontal run is 18 ft; available service-zone depth is 8 in. Two changes may be proposed for review: shorten the run to 16 ft, or deepen the zone to 8 1/2 in while keeping the 18-ft run. Other fittings, access and connections are not specified.

|---|---|
| Original horizontal run | 18 ft |
| Available zone depth | 8 in |
| Required slope | 1/4 in/ft minimum |
| Pipe outside diameter | 2 3/8 in |
| Top / bottom clearance | 3/4 in each |
| Alternative 1 | 16-ft run; 8-in zone |
| Alternative 2 | 18-ft run; 8 1/2-in zone |
